Takashi Mitsuya「三ツ谷・隆, Mitsuya Takashi」 is the second division captain of Tokyo Manji and one of its founding members . He is also the eldest brother of the Mitsuya family.

Mitsuya is a young man of medium height and a muscular body. His eyes are lavender and his short hair is light lilac. He has a piercing in his left ear, a black earring with silver crosses. He also possesses a dragon tattoo on his right temple, identical to Draken 's . The tattoo is now hidden by his hair.

He is often seen in his ToMan uniform , and when not, wears a variety of outfits; from a zip-up vest layered with a t-shirt, to a matching color block set.

In high school, Mitsuya sports a shoulder-length mullet and puts on a white t-shirt with black long sleeves.

Mitsuya is a calm and sensible person, who is also a source of positivity in the gang. He is a pacifist and prefers not to get into conflicts, but he does not hesitate to fight to defend his loved ones.

He has shown his angry side to Takemichi when he was losing and had to tell him to stay focused.

Mitsuya is also an exemplary older brother, taking care of his two younger sisters, Mana and Luna, from an early age, acting as their mother and father since their mother is rarely home due to work.

As captain of Tokyo Manji 's 2nd Division and also one of its founding members, Mitsuya has a lot of influence on the gang's decisions and can lead many criminals.

Mitsuya was able to stand after taking numerous blows from the powerful Taiju Shiba and was also able to survive a large blow to the head with a metal pipe and a brick.

Although Mitsuya is not interested in fighting and mainly tries to avoid confrontations, like most members of Toman , he is good at fighting and has demonstrated his fighting skills in several critical situations. His most notable fight was during the feud with the Black Dragon when he fought Taiju Shiba . Taiju was overwhelmingly stronger than Mitsuya, despite that, Mitsuya displayed excellent fighting tactics and Taiju had to resort to backhand tricks in order to defeat him.

Mitsuya is the leader of the home economics club at his high school. His great knowledge and sewing skills earn him the respect of his classmates (despite being a delinquent). As a way to show gratitude to Takemichi, he made him his uniform. He began sewing at an early age as a way to provide toys for his sisters since his family did not have enough money to buy them.
